title: feat(nm2readt2x): neighbor-read of M at t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis opposite x-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: Neighbor-read of M composed t+1 vs t+2 on opposite x-probes: HOLD at all four at both cuts, composition HOLD. Notes that on opposite z-probes the same bits fail at A while their composition still HOLDs - i.e. composition HOLD carries no information about the bit value.
